subject: general
question: Ashoka the Great, belonged to the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maurya Dynasty**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ashoka the Great** belonged to the **Maurya Dynasty**.
 
• The Maurya Dynasty was founded by **Chandragupta Maurya** in 322 BCE.
 
• Ashoka, one of the most famous emperors of the Maurya Dynasty, ruled from **268 to 232 BCE**.
